identity.description: BigCommerce is an ecommerce SaaS platform. Its developer docs cover the store control panel, REST and Storefront APIs, API accounts, sandboxes and MCP servers.
identity.identity_notes: Docs describe the BigCommerce store platform (store control panel, store API accounts, sandbox stores). The developer portal redirects to docs.bigcommerce.com. Sources describe the same product.

auth.oauth_flows: App-level API accounts: each installing app gets a store-specific access token (OAuth-style app install). Store Management MCP uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE per the MCP overview page. Exact OAuth grant details not fetched.
auth.token_refresh: Access tokens do not expire based on time and cannot be manually invalidated. App-level tokens are regenerated on owner email or scope change. Legacy HTTP Basic accounts are no longer available to new stores.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes should be the minimum the implementation needs. Scopes other than default include read-only variants. Store-level credential scopes are fixed after creation. Webhooks use the default scope.

access.production_restrictions: Sandbox stores cannot process live transactions. The sandbox page says sandboxes are created through the Partner Portal, which implies partner access for that path. Trial store path described in search snippet only (15 days, no credit card, unverified).

api.rate_limits: REST rate limits exist per BigCommerce docs (search snippet, not fetched). Sandbox plan shows 500,000/hr on a sandbox page. Unlimited-plan clients are not limited by request volume (search snippet, unverified).
api.limitations: Store Management MCP exposes product, inventory, order and promotion areas only (read-only or modify). Storefront MCP covers guest shopping only, no API account required. Full REST resource list not verified. GraphQL Storefront endpoint and MCP protocol noted; GraphQL rate limits not established.
